scope: Nineteen Python tests of roadmap state derivation, CLI transitions, receipt enforcement, generated-view drift and recovery using isolated temporary repositories.
limitations: Governance fixtures only; no native rebuild, provider, musical acceptance, physical audio/MIDI or H2 gate closure. Revision is the base commit; source hashes identify the tested working-tree changes.
verified_invariants: Unchanged sync and read-only check do not modify files or append duplicate events.
Completion requires exact gate, command and criterion, successful dated execution, scope and SHA-256-bound receipt/output.
Horizon advancement and reopening append transitions while preserving earlier events.
Historical completion dates require matching pre-policy events; reopening prevents reuse.
Generated roadmap and open-action drift is rejected.
Broken completion evidence can be reopened without erasing its original event.
